inputs.text: A country has the right to enforce its immigration laws, and filing for legal status should not automatically shield someone from lawful enforcement. But the government must follow its own rules: if court documents show prosecutors acknowledged the May memo did not authorize these arrests, then invoking it anyway is a serious failure of discipline and accountability. Due process is not a loophole or a favor—it is part of the rule of law. Enforce the law firmly, but don’t let agencies stretch their authority and undermine public trust.
